basic_profile.bio: John is a 28-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. With a background in computer science, he works as a software developer for a startup focusing on mobile applications. In his free time, John enjoys playing Pokémon Go, watching YouTube content, especially Logan Paul, and exploring new betting strategies with FanDuel. He is single, enjoys hanging out with friends for weekend Pokémon raids, and is typically online during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: John has a deep understanding of technology and mobile gaming, derived from his formal education in computer science and his professional experience in app development. He stays updated on the latest tech trends and gaming strategies through online forums and self-study.
